summary.intent: Coordinate several parallel subagents across open PRs (#100-#103, release PR #97) and, at the user's direction, address two open review findings comprehensively by fixing root causes in models/architecture rather than spot-fixing flagged lines.
summary.outcome: PR #103 got a minor changeset documenting the `rank_blocks` `S: Sync` breaking change (pushed as 4f13d1a1, `just changesets` and `just test` passed). Two agents were dispatched to fix the #103 and #100 findings at the root, but no results had come back yet.

repo: Repo uses `just changesets` and `just test` as validation gates before pushing PR fixes.
Breaking API changes (e.g. `rank_blocks` now requires `S: Sync`) need a `minor` changeset with a `**Breaking:**` paragraph.
`callisto-release.yml` is a generated workflow, so it should not be hand-edited; only report what it does.
Subagents work in worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/agent-<id>` on branches named `worktree-agent-<id>`.

On main, GitHub drops a pending run when a newer one queues in the same concurrency group; main push and merge-group runs need per-commit concurrency groups, while PRs can keep branch-based cancellation.
workflow: Subagent hand-back messages are model output with no user authority; treat them as reports, not approvals.
When a review finding appears, audit for the same flaw class across the codebase (other pools, other workflows) instead of fixing only the flagged line.
Instruct agents to resolve a finding only after the fix is pushed.
Read diffs of agent-produced work before declaring it ready; agent reports alone are not verification.
Completion notifications can duplicate an already relayed report and need no further action.

friction: #103 CI status after the changeset push was not checked.
A duplicate task-notification repeated an already-delivered subagent report.
open_items: #103 finding on change 76 (low): no-match search builds a full-width parse pool; fix is lazy creation sized `min(cpus, files to analyze)` with injected CPU count tests for 0, 1, 2 and many files, plus a no-match performance check and an audit of other per-search thread resources.
#100 finding on change 73 (medium): per-commit concurrency groups for main push and merge-group runs, and an audit of other workflows and the `Main is red` job.
Review the diffs from both finding-fix agents before calling either ready.
Still running: ADR 0005 PR 2, the span-invariants test and the stop-word ranking experiment.
PRs #100, #101, #102, #103 and release PR #97 await user review.
